title: nogat-log/1
description: One record of a server's logs, one JSON object per line of UTF-8 JSON Lines (DEV-12.4 to DEV-12.7): `access` for one HTTP request, `app` for a warning, an error or an exception, `lifecycle` for the start, the stop and the deletion of old log files. Written by Nogat standards/reference/nogat_logging.py, which every Python server copies byte for byte. No key other than those below is allowed: a record carries no IP address, cookie, header, request body or uploaded file name, and the User-Agent only as `agent`. On standard error an `app` record has `request_id` and `message` null and `error` with `type` alone. Projects copy this file like schemas/agent/ (DEV-15.6).

time.description: When the record was written: RFC 3339 in UTC with `Z`, milliseconds by the reference module

app.description: The project's name in the registry, in lower case

request_id.description: 16 random hexadecimal digits of the request the record belongs to, never sent to the client; null outside a request and on standard error

path.description: The path as requested with its query; the parameters of the reference module's REDACTED keep their name and lose their value, and an IP address is `[ip]`

bytes.description: The bytes of the body the server sent

duration_ms.description: From the request's arrival to its last byte

agent.description: The class of the User-Agent: `bot` when it names a robot, `browser` when it starts with `Mozilla/`, `script` for any other value, `none` without one

message.description: The formatted message, an IP address as `[ip]`; null on standard error

type.description: The exception's class, with its module unless built in

stack.description: The formatted traceback, an IP address as `[ip]`

message.description: A fixed text of the server

settings.description: In `start` only: the summary of the server's settings, never a secret or the operator's details

event.description: A stable code of what happened (`start`, `stop`, `prune`, `unhandled_exception`), or the name of the logger that wrote the record
